topic: Donating Blood at the Community Drive Center

script.title: AT THE BLOOD DRIVE
script.story_hook: First donation, and the cookies are waiting.
script.intro_zh: 第一次捐血，最後有餅乾在等你。
script.welcome_en: Hey, welcome to today's blood drive. Listen for health-check questions.
script.welcome_zh: 嗨，歡迎來到今天的捐血現場。留意健康篩檢的問句。
script.outro: One donation done, snacks earned. Listen again and repeat along.
script.outro_zh: 一袋血捐完了，點心也賺到了。再聽一遍，跟著一起說。
script.practice_intro_en: Now let's repeat each line together.
script.practice_intro_zh: 現在我們一起逐句跟讀。
script.char_a_description: a college-age young woman with a short bob dyed burgundy, silver hoop earrings, an oversized maroon college sweatshirt with a script logo, a canvas wristband, and a slim build
script.char_b_description: a broad-shouldered man in his forties with a grey-flecked buzz cut, thin wire glasses, a light blue scrub top over a dark tee, a lanyard with a clinic badge, and calm steady hands

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Hi, first blood drive ever. Where do I start?
dialogue.phonetic: /haɪ fɚst blʌd draɪv ˈivɚ wɛɹ du aɪ stɑɹt/
dialogue.zh: 嗨，我頭一回參加捐血。要從哪裡開始？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Welcome! Start at this table, photo ID please.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈwɛlkəm stɑɹt æt ðɪs ˈteɪbəl ˈfoʊtoʊ aɪˈdi pliz/
dialogue.zh: 歡迎！先到那張桌子，請出示附照片的證件。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Here it is. Um, now what?
dialogue.phonetic: /hɪɹ ɪt ɪz ʌm naʊ wʌt/
dialogue.zh: 在這兒。呃，然後呢？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Now the mini health questions, all yes or no.
dialogue.phonetic: /naʊ ðə ˈmɪni hɛlθ ˈkwɛstʃənz ɔl jɛs ɔɹ noʊ/
dialogue.zh: 接著是健康小問卷，全是是非題。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Okay, ready when you are.
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊˈkeɪ ˈɹɛdi wɛn ju ɑɹ/
dialogue.zh: 好，我準備好了，你問吧。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Feeling healthy today, any fainting history?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈfilɪŋ ˈhɛlθi təˈdeɪ ˈɛni ˈfænɪŋ ˈhɪstɚi/
dialogue.zh: 今天身體健康嗎？曾經暈倒過嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: No fainting history, and I feel fine today.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ ˈfænɪŋ ˈhɪstɚi ænd aɪ fil faɪn təˈdeɪ/
dialogue.zh: 沒有暈倒紀錄，今天感覺也挺好。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Great. Did you eat something this morning?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡɹeɪt dɪd ju ˈit ˈsʌmθɪŋ ðɪs ˈmɔɹnɪŋ/
dialogue.zh: 很好。今天早上有吃東西嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Yeah, um, eggs and toast, why?
dialogue.phonetic: /jæ ʌm ɛɡz ænd toʊst waɪ/
dialogue.zh: 有啊，嗯，雞蛋和吐司。為什麼要問？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Food matters, it keeps you steady after.
dialogue.phonetic: /fud ˈmætɚz ɪt kipz ju ˈstɛdi ˈæftɚ/
dialogue.zh: 吃很重要，捐完才不會頭暈。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Makes sense. How about water? I drank some, ha.
dialogue.phonetic: /meɪks sɛns haʊ əˈbaʊt ˈwɔɾɚ aɪ dɹæŋk sʌm hɑ/
dialogue.zh: 有道理。水呢？我今天有喝，哈。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Perfect, keep sipping today too. Ever donated?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈpɝːfɪkt kip ˈsɪpɪŋ təˈdeɪ tu ˈɛvɚ dəˈneɪɾɪd/
dialogue.zh: 完美，今天也要一直小口喝水。以前捐過嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Never! My roommate does it every season.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈnɛvɚ maɪ ˈɹuˌmeɪt dʌz ɪt ˈɛvɹi ˈsizən/
dialogue.zh: 沒有！我的室友每個季節都捐。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then today's a first — half a pint.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn təˈdeɪz ə fɝːst hæf ə paɪnt/
dialogue.zh: 那今天就是頭一回。先捐半品脫。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Half a pint? That sounds, um, real.
dialogue.phonetic: /hæf ə paɪnt ðæt ˈsaʊndz ʌm ɹiəl/
dialogue.zh: 半品脫？聽起來，嗯，還挺實際的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It regenerates in weeks, your body's fast.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt ɹiˈdʒɛnəɹeɪts ɪn wiːks jɔɹ ˈbɑdiz fæst/
dialogue.zh: 幾週就補回來，你的身體恢復得很快。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Okay, that helps. Any other checks?
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊˈkeɪ ðæt hɛps ˈɛni ˈʌðɚ tʃɛks/
dialogue.zh: 好，安心多了。還有別的檢查嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: One finger prick, we check your iron level.
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌn ˈfɪŋɡɚ prɪk wi tʃɛk jɔɹ ˈaɪɚn ˈlɛvəl/
dialogue.zh: 扎一次手指，我們看你的鐵質數值。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Iron? Like, the supplement kind?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈaɪɚn laɪk ðə ˈsʌpləmənt kaɪnd/
dialogue.zh: 鐵？就是營養補充劑那種鐵？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Exactly that. Low iron means no donation today.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪɡˈzæktli ðæt loʊ ˈaɪɚn miːnz noʊ doʊˈneɪʃən təˈdeɪ/
dialogue.zh: 正是。鐵太低，今天就不能捐。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Got it. Prick me, I'm brave today.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡɑɾ ɪt prɪk mi aɪm bɹeɪv təˈdeɪ/
dialogue.zh: 記下了。來扎吧，我今天很勇敢。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ready… and the number is, hmm, twelve point one.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈɹɛdi ænd ðə ˈnʌmbɚ ɪz hə m twɛlv pɔɪnt wʌn/
dialogue.zh: 準備好……數值是，嗯，十二點一。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is that passing or… you went quiet.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪz ðæt ˈpæsɪŋ ɔɹ ju wɛnt ˈkwaɪət/
dialogue.zh: 這算過了還是……你怎麼沉默了？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It's a hair below the line, I'm sorry.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪts ə hɛɹ bɪˈhoʊ ðə laɪn aɪm ˈsɑɹi/
dialogue.zh: 差一點點在線下面，很抱歉。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Oh no, really? I came all ready.
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊ noʊ ˈɹiəli aɪ keɪm ɔl ˈɛdi/
dialogue.zh: 噢不，真的嗎？我全都準備好才來的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You can try again — water, ten minutes, rest.
dialogue.phonetic: /ju kən traɪ əˈɡɛn ˈwɔɾɚ tɛn ˈmɪnəts ɹɛst/
dialogue.zh: 你可以再試一次——喝水、休息十分鐘。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Retests actually work? People pass the second time?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˌɹiˈtɛsts ˈæktʃuəli wɝk ˈpipəl pæs ðə ˈsɛkənd taɪm/
dialogue.zh: 重測真的有用嗎？有人第二次就過了？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Often, yes, hydration moves that number.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈɔfən jɛs haɪˈdreɪʃən muvz ðæt ˈnʌmbɚ/
dialogue.zh: 常常會，水分足夠，數字就上來。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Then yes, point me at the water.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn jɛs pɔɪnt mi æt ðə ˈwɔɾɚ/
dialogue.zh: 那我要再試，水桶在哪裡？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Big jug right there, grab a chair too.
dialogue.phonetic: /bɪɡ dʒʌɡ ɹaɪt ðɛɹ ɡɹæb ə tʃɛɹ tu/
dialogue.zh: 大水桶就在那邊，順便搬張椅子。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Ten minutes later… okay, do the finger again.
dialogue.phonetic: /tɛn ˈmɪnəts ˈleɪɾɚ oʊˈkeɪ du ðə ˈfɪŋɡɚ əˈɡɛn/
dialogue.zh: 過了十分鐘……好，再扎一次手指。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Straight arm, squeeze… and it's thirteen point two!
dialogue.phonetic: /stɹeɪt ɑɹm skwiːz ænd ɪts ˌθɝˈtin pɔɪnt tu/
dialogue.zh: 手臂放直，握拳……十三點二！

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Wait, is that above? You're smiling!
dialogue.phonetic: /weɪt ɪz ðæt əˈbʌv jʊɹz ˈsmaɪɪŋ/
dialogue.zh: 等等，這算過線了吧？你在笑耶！

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Above the line. You're donating today, congrats.
dialogue.phonetic: /əˈbʌv ðə laɪn jʊɹ doʊˈneɪɾɪŋ təˈdeɪ kənˈɡɹæts/
dialogue.zh: 過線了。今天你能捐，恭喜你。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Yes! Um, which chair is mine?
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs ʌm wɪtʃ tʃɛɹ ɪz maɪn/
dialogue.zh: 太好了！嗯，哪張椅子是我的？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The recliner by the window, it's comfy.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɪ ɹɪˈklaɪnɚ baɪ ðə ˈwɪndoʊ ɪts ˈkʌmfi/
dialogue.zh: 窗邊那張躺椅，最舒服的一張。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Nice view at least, ha. About the needle…
dialogue.phonetic: /naɪs vju æt list hɑ əˈbaʊt ðə ˈnidəl/
dialogue.zh: 至少風景不錯，哈。那個針……

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The poke scares most people. Totally fair.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə poʊk skɛɚz moʊst ˈpipəl ˈtɑɾəli fɛɹ/
dialogue.zh: 多數人最怕這一下，很合理。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can I look away, or must I watch?
dialogue.phonetic: /kən aɪ lʊk əˈweɪ ɔɹ məst aɪ wɑtʃ/
dialogue.zh: 我可以別過頭嗎，還是必須看著？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Look away, squeeze this ball when you can.
dialogue.phonetic: /lʊk əˈweɪ skwiːz ðɪs bɔl wɛn ju kən/
dialogue.zh: 別過頭，有空就捏這個壓力球。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Deal. Do I count down from ten?
dialogue.phonetic: /dil du aɪ kaʊnt daʊn fɹʌm tɛn/
dialogue.zh: 成交。我從十倒數好嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Count up from one, it slows your brain.
dialogue.phonetic: /kaʊnt ʌp fɹʌm wʌn ɪt sloʊz jɔɹ breɪn/
dialogue.zh: 從一正數，腦袋會慢下來，比較不怕。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Ha, weird trick. Does it take long?
dialogue.phonetic: /hɑ wɪɹd trɪk dʌz ɪt teɪk lɔŋ/
dialogue.zh: 哈，奇怪的招。會很久嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: About ten minutes, then you're officially a hero.
dialogue.phonetic: /əˈbaʊt tɛn ˈmɪnəts ðɛn jʊɹ əˈfɪʃəli ə ˈhɪɹoʊ/
dialogue.zh: 大約十分鐘，之後你就是官方認證的英雄。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That I can do. Okay, closing my eyes.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt aɪ kən du oʊˈkeɪ ˈkloʊzɪŋ maɪ aɪz/
dialogue.zh: 這我辦得到。好，我要閉眼了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Breathe deep… and that's done, all smooth.
dialogue.phonetic: /bɹið dip ænd ðæts dʌn ɔl smus/
dialogue.zh: 深呼吸……好了，全程很順利。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Already? Um, I didn't feel much, wow.
dialogue.phonetic: /əˈlɛdi ʌm aɪ dɪdnt fil mʌtʃ waʊ/
dialogue.zh: 就這樣？嗯，我幾乎沒感覺，哇。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Stay reclined fifteen minutes, that's the rule.
dialogue.phonetic: /steɪ ɹɪˈklaɪnd ˌfɪfˈtin ˈmɪnəts ðæts ðə ɹul/
dialogue.zh: 請躺著別動十五分鐘，這是規定。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Fifteen? Can I at least reach my phone?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˌfɪfˈtin kən aɪ ət list ɹitʃ maɪ foʊn/
dialogue.zh: 十五分鐘？至少讓我拿手機滑一下吧？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Totally, scroll away, snacks are coming after.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈtɑɾəli skɹoʊl əˈweɪ snæks ɑɹ ˈkʌmɪŋ ˈæftɚ/
dialogue.zh: 當然，隨便滑，點心等一下就送來。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Snack question: is the cookie part of this?
dialogue.phonetic: /snæk ˈkwɛstʃən ɪz ðə ˈkʊki pɑɹt əv ðɪs/
dialogue.zh: 想問點心：餅乾也是流程的一部分嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Cookies are half the reason people come back.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈkʊkɪz ɑɹ hæf ðə ˈɹizən ˈpipəlz kʌm bæk/
dialogue.zh: 有一半的人回來，就是為了餅乾。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Then I'll be a regular, for the cookie.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn aɪl bi ə ˈɹɛɡjəlɚ fɚ ðə ˈkʊki/
dialogue.zh: 那我會變成常客的，為了餅乾。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Juice box too, and pretzels if you like.
dialogue.phonetic: /dʒus bɑks tu ænd ˈpɹɛtsəlz ɪf ju laɪk/
dialogue.zh: 還有果汁盒，喜歡的話也有鹹脆餅。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: All three, please. I earned, um, all three.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɔl θɹi pliz aɪ ˈɝnd ʌm ɔl θɹi/
dialogue.zh: 三樣都要，謝謝。我值得，嗯，三樣。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Rest, snack, then I'll stamp your record card.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɹɛst snæk ðɛn aɪl stæmp jɔɹ ˈɹɛkɚd kɑɹd/
dialogue.zh: 先休息吃點心，然後我幫你在紀錄卡蓋章。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do I get a sticker? My roommate got one.
dialogue.phonetic: /du aɪ ɡɛt ə ˈstɪkɚ maɪ ˈɹuˌmeɪt ɡɑt wʌn/
dialogue.zh: 有貼紙嗎？我室友每次都有拿到。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You do, and the card says fifty-six days.
dialogue.phonetic: /ju du ænd ðə kɑɹd sɛz ˌfɪftiˈsɪks deɪz/
dialogue.zh: 有，卡上還會寫：下次要隔五十六天。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Fifty-six days. Noted. I'm already planning, ha.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˌfɪftiˈsɪks deɪz ˈnoʊtɪd aɪm ɔlˈɹɛdi ˈplænɪŋ hɑ/
dialogue.zh: 五十六天，記下了。我已經在計劃下一輪了，哈。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Take it slow standing up. Bye, hero.
dialogue.phonetic: /teɪk ɪt sloʊ ˈstændɪŋ ʌp baɪ ˈhɪɹoʊ/
dialogue.zh: 起身記得慢一點喔。再見了，小英雄。

script.youtube_title: 【人生第一次捐血🩸】「餅乾是回來的原因」🍪鐵值差一點該怎麼辦😳重測過關全流程🎧60句沉浸式英語聽力｜Donating Blood at a Drive
script.youtube_title_en: "Cookies Are Half the Reason" — Donating Blood for the Very First Time
script.youtube_description:
「有一半的人回來，就是為了餅乾」——第一次捐血會遇到什麼？鐵值差一點點還有救嗎？這一集是 60 句沉浸式英語聽力練習，場景就在社區中心的捐血日。

你會聽到：報到與健康小問卷的是非題說法；喝水休息之後重測鐵值通過的完整過程；躺上捐血椅之前怎麼緊張地聊天、怕針時怎麼請求別過頭；還有捐完十五分鐘的強制休息、餅乾果汁點心的選擇、下一次捐血要隔的五十六天。

整段對話只用 A2 初級單字與短句，反覆出現美國人閒聊的真實語感：um、yeah、ha、wow、okay。聽完你就會用：Where do I start、Does it take long、Can I look away、All three please。

後半段是逐句聽力＋跟讀練習，請大聲跟著唸，讓舌頭先學會，腦袋自然就記住。

不用背，多聽就會用。每天一集，把英文聽成直覺。

#EnglishListening #ESL #LearnEnglish｜喜歡的話請按訂閱與小鈴鐺。
script.youtube_description_en:
"Cookies are half the reason people come back" — what actually happens on your first blood donation day? This is a 60-line immersive English listening practice set at a community center blood drive.

You will hear: check-in and the mini health questions; the finger-prick iron test, and the water-plus-ten-minute rest that saves a borderline result; small talk in the recliner when the needle scares you; the fifteen-minute rest rule, snack choices, stickers, and the fifty-six-day waiting window.

Everything stays in A2-level words with the casual rhythm Americans use while donating: um, yeah, ha, wow, okay. By the end you'll own phrases like Where do I start, Can I look away, and Does it take long.

The second half is a line-by-line listen-and-repeat workout, so speak out loud and let your mouth learn first.

No memorizing needed — just listen often and it sticks.

#EnglishListening #ESL #LearnEnglish — subscribe for a new scene every day.
script.youtube_title_ref: 【🎬沉浸式英文動畫】🎧捐血日英文對話｜健康篩檢・鐵值重測・點心感謝｜第一次捐血全程會聽到什麼｜🌱A2 初級英文｜💡不用背，多聽就會用｜🎧聽力口說練習｜後段逐句跟讀
script.youtube_description_ref:
📌 影片簡介：
第一次去捐血，不知道接下來會遇到什麼流程？手指一扎，鐵值差一點點，今天是不是就白來了？躺上椅子之後，怕針的話可以別過頭嗎？

這一集帶大家走進社區中心的捐血日，從報到、健康問卷、鐵值重測，一路聽到躺椅上的聊天、十五分鐘休息與餅乾點心，共 60 句連續真實對話。

你會聽到：
🩸 篩檢問句：Feeling healthy today, any fainting history?
💧 補救方案：You can try again — water, ten minutes, rest.
😳 怕針求助：Can I look away, or must I watch?
🍪 點心時間：Cookies are half the reason people come back.

後半段是逐句聽力＋跟讀練習：每一句先聽兩遍，再跟著大聲說一遍，把 um、yeah、ha 這些自然語感唸進直覺裡。🎧

🌱 適合 A2 初級英文學習者：不用背單字、不用學文法，多聽就會用。跟著這趟捐血走完一趟，下次你真的坐進活動中心，句子自己就會冒出來。

祝你也勇敢捐出一袋熱血。
